messages:
Arjun (VP Eng): follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring windows + the small platform reorg. putting a few clarifications here and opening for quick Qs. link to the short note: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/hiring-windows :wave:

Lily (People Ops): TL;DR: headcount envelope is approved. two new terms to know: 'shadow req' = placeholder for forecasting (not a live job), and 'hiring window' = tranche when roles can be opened. we'll publish templates for both.

Dani - Eng: q1: can managers create shadow reqs now for long-lead roles (e.g., senior infra) or wait for comp bands?

Lily (People Ops): yes, create shadow reqs now. mark them as `shadow:true` in the intake notes. shadow reqs do not consume budget and won't go to recruiters until you flip them to live after comp bands. helps PMs/Eng plan candidate pipelines.

Marcus - Product: question about relocation and sign-on: any changes in policy for high-priority hires tied to Dedicated?

Arjun (VP Eng): for Q1 high-priority Dedicated hires we can approve a limited relocation stipend case-by-case. flag `relocation:required` in the intake and include why. comp approvals still required.

Dani - Eng: are interns part of this envelope? we rely on interns for summer projects and don't want a hiring gap.

Lily (People Ops): interns are in a separate bucket. Summer intern hire freeze is lifted for FY26; submit intern reqs with `intern:true` and expected dates.

Marcus - Product: reorg scope - will product managers move between squads or will we keep PMs aligned to product areas?

Arjun (VP Eng): PMs stay aligned to product areas. a small number of platform PMs will now report to the new platform director to reduce cross-team coordination. no headcount is removed.

Dani - Eng: any new interview panel guidance? small infra teams are getting overbooked.

Lily (People Ops): recommended = hiring manager + 2 cross-functional interviewers. use the new interviewer pool rota (link in playbook) to avoid burn. we capped interview loops at 3 stages by default.

Dani - Eng: one more: can we start passive outreach for shadow reqs so we're ready when windows open?

Lily (People Ops): yes, passive outreach ok for shadow reqs if you mark `prep_outreach:true`. recruiters will coordinate but won't post the role until the window opens and bands are set.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: intake form -> https://redwood.example.com/hr/intake (auto-post)

Arjun (VP Eng): thanks all. i'll monitor for 45m. if you need escalation for urgent roles, add a note with `escalate:vp-eng` on the intake and cc me. :thumbsup:
